title: orm recipe
description: The recipe format of docs/spec/feature-coverage.md (FCV-2 to FCV-4). A recipe with a fixture expects the databases that run the step: mysql, postgres and sqlite, or those of its only; a recipe without one expects exactly none.

version.description: The version of a recipe that carries its own vector note (tests/dbspec/plan-cases.json).

note.description: The note of a recipe that carries its own vector note (tests/dbspec/plan-cases.json).

fixture.description: A dbspec-set.json document set, or none: the cases of a recipe with fixture none run on an empty case database (FCV-3).

schema.description: The schema manifest that the ir.validate steps check their requests against, relative to the recipe file.

textLine.description: A line of a dbspec.format text, or a form that a helper expands to lines, so that a long document need not be written out in full: repeat gives its lines count times with {var} replaced by from, from + 1, ...; fill gives one line of its text repeated count times.

model.description: The model name as the generator spells it, such as CompositeAccount (FCV-4).

after.description: The statement that runs once the rows of the seed are written, for what those rows leave behind (FCV-13).

install.description: false: the helper installs no fixture before the steps, which install it with schema.install (statement_events).

not_through_pooler.description: Why the case needs a direct server. The pooler lane (client-pooler-check) leaves it out; the direct lanes run it.

value.description: A recipe wrapper: one key that names the form of the value.

f64.description: A non-finite binary64 number (the bind vectors of tests/bind/vectors.json); a finite one is a float wrapper.

caseId.description: A case id: a name whose hyphens name the case of a plan vector (tests/dbspec/plan-*.json).

encodeArgument.description: The value of codec.encode: an argument, or an ordered_json wrapper, the ordered-json value of its value whatever the stages (FCV-4).

oneOf.description: The form of an envelope with a random nonce: bytes of that length that start with that lowercase hex.

message_suffix.description: The text that the message of the error ends with.

message_holds.description: The text that the message of the error holds, for a message that the driver wraps.

rollback.description: The code of the error of the failed rollback that a ROLLBACK error keeps; its message holds the text of that error (CFG-15).

keeps_callback.description: A ROLLBACK error keeps the error that the callback of its transaction returned (CFG-15).

driver_cause.description: The error keeps the error of the driver as its cause (Go errors.Unwrap, PHP getPrevious, TypeScript cause, Python __cause__, Rust source).

expect.description: The outcome of each database: the databases that run the step, or exactly none; the root selects which, and scripts/features/recipes.test.mts checks that the names are exactly those databases (FCV-4, FCV-10).

schema.description: The schema name, or one for each database. The text $database is the name of the case database.
The schema name, or one for each database. The text $database is the name of the case database.

message_contains.description: With an expected error: the text that its message holds.

steps.description: An empty transaction is a statement-free BEGIN and COMMIT.

audit.description: The audit values of the transaction, column names of the audit record table and their values; an empty object is an audit transaction with no value of its own (CFG-8, DSL-126).

isolation.description: The isolation level of the transaction; a nested transaction that names one is refused with CONFIG.

read_only.description: A read-only transaction; a nested transaction that names it is refused with CONFIG.

timeout_ms.description: The timeout of the transaction (INT-42); a nested transaction that names it is refused with CONFIG.

default_retry.description: The transaction names no retry and takes the default of INT-43; without it and without retry the helper passes a retry of 0.

conflicts.description: The first attempts that end with the public transaction conflict (INT-48) after their steps.

op.description: The runs of the callback of the transaction step that ended last, whatever its outcome.
Two execution flows at read_committed with a retry of 3: flow i writes flow-<i> to column of rows[i], holds it until the other flow holds its row, then writes rows[1-i] (PLN-24).

expect.description: attempts counts the callback runs of both flows, deadlocks the first attempts that ended with DEADLOCK, and same_flow holds when both rows hold the name of one flow.

corpus.description: The corpus of the markdown DSN.

token.description: The token of the markdown DSN.

replies.description: The lines that the listener answers, in order, one for each line it receives.

messages.description: The lines that the listener must have received when the connection closes.

corpus.description: The corpus of the markdown DSN.

token.description: The token of the markdown DSN.

reply.description: The line that a listener answers the first message with.

received.description: The line that the listener must have received.

name.description: The file name of the SQLite DSN in a new directory (CFG-26).

query.description: The query of the SQLite DSN.

config.description: The AES configuration of the connection, as in the config of dsn.connect (COD-8).

dsn.description: The DSN of the case database for case, otherwise the DSN text of the step (FCV-4).

query.description: The parameters that dsn.connect adds to the DSN of the case database (FCV-4).

config.description: The connection configuration of dsn.connect, by the name of each field in Rust (CFG-4, CFG-5, CFG-6).

session_read.description: The connection also runs this statement, whose only row must read as these texts, cell by cell (CFG-3).

tls_version.description: The connection also reads its Ssl_version, which is TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.3 (CFG-16).

dbspec.apply_fault.description: The public apply or rollback on a memory SQLite connection that the op wraps: after applied_first and sql, the nth read of the SQLite master query in the call fails with an error of the op. Statements of fail_statements fail in the call, and stop_on_applied stops the call at its first applied event. The result is the code of the apply error, its failure and its cleanup errors (PLN-92, PLN-93, PLN-96, PLN-106).

dbspec.ddl_behavior.description: On one native connection of the case database: the connection rules, the statements of the case for the database, then its behavior steps (DIA-113).

dbspec.introspect.description: Renders a document set for the database, applies it on one native connection of the case database with the statements of its vector, introspects that database and compares the result (DIA-133) and the catalog queries (DIA-198).

catalog_of.description: Introspects the empty case database with the catalog queries of this other dialect, which fail.

pool_lifetime_ms.description: The lifetime of a pool connection in milliseconds (CFG-5).

statement_timeout_ms.description: The statement bound of the connection (CFG-6).

dsn.description: Absent: the case database. "case" is its DSN, "case?<query>" its DSN with those parameters, "case-pooler" the case database through ORM_TEST_PGBOUNCER_DSN (CFG-27), "case-socket" its MySQL DSN through the socket ORM_TEST_MYSQL_SOCKET (CFG-10, CFG-19; a MySQL-only recipe unit, FCV-3); otherwise the DSN text of the step (FCV-4).

audit_source.description: The audit source of the connection (CFG-8): the values it returns, or fail, a source whose own error fails the transaction.

row.description: The bound collection that connect rebinds (INT-85).

schema.description: The schema manifest of the request, relative to the recipe file.

assemble_types.description: Adds the type of each output column of a plan step, by name, to the statements that the step compares.

input.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by schema.

message.description: The exact text of the error of every dialect, when the case holds it.

lines.description: A schema text, one string per line (docs/spec/dbspec.md).
A plan text, one string per line (docs/spec/plans.md).

source.description: The schema the plan changes; null is the empty schema.

text.description: The plan text of EmitPlan: the lines of the plan, each ended by a newline.

dbspec.introspect_refusal.description: Introspection on an in-memory SQLite connection with a dialect that is none of DBS-174.

source.description: The schema the plan changes; null is the empty schema.

dialect.description: A dialect of DBS-174; any other name expects refused.

steps.description: The steps of PlanSteps in order, each the object of docs/spec/plans.md (Steps).

refused.description: The call refuses this dialect before any statement (DBS-174).

schema.description: The schema manifest of the request, relative to the recipe file.

input.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by schema.

schema.description: The schema manifest of the request, relative to the recipe file.

input.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by schema.

names.description: The output names of the first statement whose columns the expect states.

manifest_hash.description: The hash the request holds in place of the hash of the schema of the recipe: a request of another manifest.

request.description: A request of the protocol (docs/spec/protocol.md) without manifest_hash; the step adds the hash of the schema named by the schema key of the recipe.

chain.description: The case of tests/markdown/cases.json that the chain runs (tests/markdown/README.md).

answer.description: The answer of the chain's one request, as the case gives it (docs/spec/protocol.md section 5, Read).

answers.description: The answers of a transaction chain keyed by the op of each control message and the kind of each request.

value.description: The result of the chain in the plain JSON form of tests/markdown/README.md, a row, a list, a count, a value or {error, runs}.

params.description: The params of the one request that the listener received (PRT-66, PRT-67), in the JSON form of PRT-67; the now of the message is not compared.

surface.description: A public call that has no form on a markdown connection (DIA-183 to DIA-189), run in place of a statement.

column.description: A parameter slot of the bind fixture (tests/bind/slots.dbs): <table>.<column>. The statement reads that column with the operator and one parameter.

operator.description: eq compares the column with the parameter through the chain method without an operator; like_contains compares it with the pattern that contains the parameter (the transform of tests/bind/vectors.json); eq_method, ne_method and gt_method call the chain method of the operator Eq, Ne or Gt.

params.description: The one parameter of the statement, a recipe wrapper.

process_zone.description: An IANA zone name that is the process default zone while the case runs, restored after it. An offset-less datetime is a wall clock in the connection zone, not in this zone (docs/spec/protocol.md section 5).

begin.description: A transaction begin on the connection, sent in place of a statement.

message.description: The JSON that the listener receives first: the begin message of a begin, or the JSON of the parameter of a statement (runtime value model, docs/spec/protocol.md section 5), or the empty list `[]` of a statement that binds no parameter (a nil compared with eq is IS NULL, DSL-48).

error.description: The code of the error that the public call returns before any message is sent.

model.description: The generated model of the bind fixture (tests/bind/slots.dbs).

column.description: A column of the model, set through its public setter.

value.description: A recipe wrapper, the value that the setter takes.

message.description: The JSON of the one parameter of the insert statement.

fault.next_rollback.description: Arms the rollback fault of the test entry point of the client on the connection (PRT-43 and its peers).

transaction.writers.description: writers writers at the same time, each on its own connection or process, each committing writes transactions that read the Service count and insert one Service without retries; its value is the Service count (CFG-12).

database.read_only.description: Makes the SQLite file of the case database one that the process may only read.

db.listen.description: Calls listen of the connection and binds the subscription with as.

subscription.receive.description: The next notification of the subscription, as its channel and its payload or the size of its payload, within the deadline of within_ms.

session.end_listener.description: Ends the server session that listens on the channel, through the server DSN.

replica.await.description: Returns after the replica has applied every change that the primary committed before the step.

row.connect.description: Calls connect of the row that row holds, with the connection that connection names.

wait.start.description: Records the time for the next wait.at_least.

wait.at_least.description: Fails the step when fewer than ms milliseconds passed since wait.start.

session.end.description: Ends, through the native driver on the server DSN of the database, the server session that holds a lock on the table (CFG-15).

refused.description: The database must refuse the statement; the step fails when it succeeds. A driver error of any code passes.

refused_message.description: With refused: the text that the error message of the driver holds, compared in lower case, so that a refusal for another reason fails the step.

table.description: The text of the call, which a case of a refused reference holds as it is.
The text of the call, which a case of a quoted name holds as it is.

column_name.description: The name that replaces the name of the first column of the descriptor of the page.

primary_key.description: The key columns that replace the primary key of the descriptor of the page.

limit.description: The limit that replaces the limit of the page.

result_column_name.description: The name that replaces the name of the first column of the result of the page.

drop_last_cell.description: Removes the last cell of the first row of the page.

fill_last_cell.description: Replaces the last cell of the first row of the page with the text fill repeated count times.

unconnected.description: The model is built with no connection: it runs in the active transaction of the flow, or is refused with CONFIG (PLN-16).

rows_sequence.description: count rows whose column runs from `from`, each with values (a batch-limit case states its size, not its rows).

unconnected.description: The model is built with no connection: it runs in the active transaction of the flow, or is refused with CONFIG (PLN-16).

from.description: The chain that model.chain bound by this name: the query continues it.

ordered_text.description: The result is the text of the ordered-json value that the row holds in this column (DIA-26).

json_output.description: The result is the model JSON output text of the row: its members in row order, and each styled value with its stored document text (COD-26).

ordered_text.description: The result is the text of the ordered-json value that the row holds in this column (DIA-26).

json_output.description: The result is the model JSON output text of the row: its members in row order, and each styled value with its stored document text (COD-26).

ordered_text.description: The result is the text of the ordered-json value that the row holds in this column (DIA-26).

from.description: The chain that model.chain bound by this name: the query continues it.

pick.description: The fields of each result row that the expect names; a field the expect does not name is not compared.

connect.description: The related model is connected to the connection of the query; without it the related model takes the connection of its parent (INT-87).

many.description: relations(child): the result is a collection, one output row per child row (INT-87).

alias.description: The result name, given through the generated alias method of the child and read through its generated getter.

lock.description: The row lock of the query; outside a transaction it is refused with CONFIG.

tuples.description: The rows whose key columns equal one tuple of values (DSL-82, the generated tuple filter of a composite key).

page.description: The query reads one page by GetsPage: offset/limit+1 of size limit, with the total of the rows (INT-36).

bytes_hex_of.description: The result is the lowercase hex of the bytes that each row holds in this column, read through the row, in result order (PRT-69, INT-5).

key_by.description: The column that keys the collection of the result (PRT-35).

group_value.description: The result is Value of this name on the first group row of the count aggregate (INT-31).

from.description: The chain that model.chain bound by this name: the query continues it.

pick.description: The fields of each result row that the expect names; a field the expect does not name is not compared.

plan.description: The page is read by getPagePlanSteps (DSL-159): the role and tables of each step, with the counts of plan_count.

plan_page.description: The page and size that plan passes as they are, refused values included, in place of those of limit; limit then belongs to the chain unless page is set.

plan_sql.description: Each step of plan also holds sql, the text of its statement.

unconnected.description: The chain is built without connecting its model: connection then names nothing that runs.

plan_count.description: The texts counted in the upper-cased statement of each step of plan.

items.description: The json of a page also holds items, the rows of the page narrowed to pick.

compile.description: The query is read by getQuery: its text and binds, not its rows.

op.description: Runs steps twice on the connection and reads, by the difference of probe, the server transactions of each run (INT-149).

probe.description: One statement whose single integer cell grows with the server transactions of the connection.

first_run_prepare_clients.description: The clients whose first run prepares each distinct text in a round trip of its own, one more transaction for each.

conflict.description: After its statements the function fails with the retryable DEADLOCK error of this message (INT-48).

masks.description: The bind values no recipe can fix, per database, by event and bind position: a random nonce or the clock, named in value, with the reason.

reason.description: Why no recipe can fix this value.

dialect.description: A dialect name that the call refuses (DBS-174); absent renders all three dialects.

refused.description: The call refuses this dialect before any statement (DBS-174).

documents.description: The documents of one set, relative to the recipe file.

external.description: The external documents of the set, relative to the recipe file.

entities.description: The entity names, in the order of DBS-111.

models.description: The values to compare, by entity name: the keys it names of table, primary_key, identity, updated, soft_delete, aes_version, audit_column, audit_record, key_names and fields, and of a field type, nullable, default, default_now, select_explicit, codec, blind_index, primary_key and foreign_key.

dsn.description: The connection of the catalog: case-pooler is the case database through the transaction pooler (FCV-4 model.connect). Absent is the DSN of the case.

user_from_database.description: The prefix of the user of the new connection: the prefix and the last 28 characters of the name of the case database, on the DSN of the case without a password.

refused_message.description: The server must refuse the connection: the text that the error message of the driver holds, compared in lower case. The connection of the case stays.

refused_code.description: With refused_message: the code of the error of that refusal.

user_from_database.description: The user whose place the native connection holds, named as catalog.reconnect names it. The connection stays open until sql.release_connection.

sql.hold_statement.description: A second client, the native driver of the runtime on dsn, runs sql with its one integer parameter bind as a protocol-level named statement. The first column of sql is pg_backend_pid(), and as binds its value of the first row, so that a later step compares the server connection it reached. The connection stays open until sql.release_connection.

catalog.revision_compare.description: Compares the revision of a snapshot with the revision of another: the outcome is the json {"length": the characters of the revision, "differs": whether the two differ}.

document_set.description: The dbspec-set.json of the generation, relative to the recipe file.

unchanged.description: The lines of the check of the files as generated.

changed.description: The lines of the check after one byte of one generated file changed; <file> is that file as the runtime names it.

removed.description: The lines of the check after that file was removed.

free_tail.description: True for a set error or a file diagnostic, whose message after its parts each runtime words itself.

files.description: The tree of the generation, with dbspec-set.json at its root: a name to its text, or to the path of a file to copy, relative to the recipe file.

check.description: True runs the check of the generated files in place of the generation.

parts.description: The texts that the output of the refusal holds, each after the one before it, and nothing after the last unless free_tail.

schema.description: The .dbs manifest of the generation, relative to the recipe file.

schema_replace.description: A text of the document of schema and the text that replaces it before the generation, so that one document holds the column names that the generator refuses.

used.description: Other document sets that the generation uses, relative to the recipe file.

before.description: Another set's output that the generation follows: the .dbs manifest schema, relative to the recipe file, generated first into output, with the scan of the source directory scan.

sources.description: The scanned sources of each runtime language, each a tree of path to text.

text.description: Texts that the generated files of the set hold together, and texts that they do not hold.

message.description: A text that the error contains.

position.description: The source position of a file that does not parse (DSL-152): its line, and its column where the parser gives one.

text.description: The lines of a dbspec document, joined with LF and a final LF (docs/spec/mermaid.md).

set.description: The other documents of the set that the text uses, by name, each the lines of a document joined as text is.

document.description: A .dbs file, relative to the recipe file.

value.description: A subset of {mermaid: <text>, dropped: [[kind, table, name], ...]}, plain JSON; the keys it names are compared.

mermaid.description: The Mermaid text, or a ref to the mermaid of an export.

name.description: The name of the imported document.

skeleton_of.description: A .dbs file, relative to the recipe file, whose tables, columns, primary keys and foreign keys the import must return.

value.description: A subset of {document, dropped, same_skeleton} or {errors}, plain JSON; the keys it names are compared.

as.description: The name of the hooked handle; the connection keeps its name, unhooked.

edge.description: Which side of a write this read bounds: lower gives the reading of the wall clock, upper the latest value the client can write from that reading.

as.description: The name that binds the UTC text of six fraction digits, for a bind of a later step.

values.description: The values of the restore; an empty object is the restore without key values, which IR_INVALID refuses.

columns.description: The columns of the restored row that the rows expect compares.

model.chain.description: Builds a query without running it, bound by `as`: a later query, count or page continues it through `from`.

op.description: The rows that the last write of the connection matched, through the test entry point of the runtime (F15).

call.description: grantTable, inspectTable or revokeTable of utils().privileges() (INT-59).

table.description: The table argument of the call, passed as it is.

role.description: The role argument of grant and revoke, passed as it is.

privilege.description: The privilege argument of revoke, passed as it is.

through.description: pooler connects through ORM_TEST_PGBOUNCER_DSN; a missing variable fails the case.

plans.description: The bound plans of dbspec.plan, in chain order.

count.description: The event kinds that the value counts, each as a member of its own, and an empty list counts none; a member events counts every event when absent.

detail.description: A text that the message of the failure holds, compared without case.

message.description: The whole message of a failure that is not an apply error; the code of the value is then message.

elapsed.description: The bounds of the time that the command takes, in milliseconds.

on.description: What the event handler does at the first event of the kind, or at each with every: an event may also name its plan and step; the nested steps run, and then stop ends the command, whose code is then stopped.

message_suffix.description: The text that the message of the error ends with.

oneOf.description: A page whose cell is too large to state in the recipe: its columns and has_more.

json.description: The result of a model op of the table path, as plain JSON: rows as objects in the order the query returned them, a scalar as itself (FCV-4).

oneOf.description: The styled value of its value (a column with a codec of a styled value).
Explicit connectors in order: [connector, predicate] or a bare [connector], whose next condition has no connector of its own (DSL-7).

The boolean full-text search of a text in the columns of the model (DSL-32).

connect.description: The joined model is connected to the connection of the query, which is refused (DSL-98).

match.description: The pair [column of the query, column of the joined model].

force_index.description: The index that the joined table is read through (DSL-90).

connection.description: A bound connection that the child connects to (PLN-42).

limit.description: The limit of the related model, which is refused with LIMIT_IN_RELATION.

bytes_hex_of.description: The result is the lowercase hex of the bytes that each row holds in this column, read through the row, in result order (PRT-69, INT-5).

qualifiedName.description: A name, or a dotted name: alias.column of a joined model (FCV-4 query fields) or a dotted local name (utils.set_local).

dsn.description: A DSN: sqlite_file absent names a SQLite file that the case does not create; url is a DSN text that no dialect serves.

only.description: The databases that run a step or a case; a step or a case without it runs on every database.
